title: Kirby Problem 5.13
exact_target: Do finite-volume hyperbolic manifolds virtually have positive first Betti number, a free-group quotient, a cubulation, and, in odd dimension, a fibration over the circle?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3020 (KP-5.13). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (eds.), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295, American Mathematical Society (2026), Problem 5.13, author preliminary version.
